title: Derivations bound normalization in degree-p purely inseparable extensions of normal Noetherian domains
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof differentiates p-th powers of integral elements, lowers their polynomial degree, and inductively obtains a uniform denominator bound for every coefficient. The resulting finite-module containment proves normalization finiteness in a genuinely inseparable setting beyond ordinary qualification algebra.
